description: A sweet summer candid from July 31, 1939, capturing a blonde toddler standing atop the curved stone front stoop of a multi-story brick apartment building in St. Louis, Missouri. The young child wears a tailored light-and-dark romper featuring an elephant applique on the bib, white socks, and soft white walking shoes. The child looks intently downward, absorbed in watching a caterpillar crawling on the step below. Thick bushes and an ornamental stone urn decorate the entryway behind the child. Captured just weeks before the outbreak of World War II in Europe, this snapshot preserves an enduring and innocent moment of childhood curiosity during the closing months of the Great Depression era.
